Original task baseline: app/redirect.py. Expired sessions must use the shared LOGIN route at /login; active sessions must keep /dashboard. Preserve shared route indirection. No authentication framework.

Reproduction: run "'`"<TRAILBUN_SOURCE>\\\\.git\\\\native-venv\\\\Scripts\\\\python.exe\" -B acceptance.py"'`.

Cause: the shared route has the old value and the redirect ignores session expiry.

Authorized scope extension: change app/routes.py because the shared LOGIN value must become /login; changing only app/redirect.py cannot meet that requirement. The original baseline remains app/redirect.py.

Next experiment: import the routes module in app/redirect.py, return routes.LOGIN for expired sessions and /dashboard otherwise, update LOGIN to /login, then rerun unchanged acceptance.py.
